title.en: Convexity, gradient methods, and unconstrained optimisation
title.zh: 凸性、梯度方法与无约束优化

lead.en: Prove convexity and descent statements under explicit assumptions, analyse quadratic eigenmodes and conditioning, and distinguish gradient, Newton and coordinate updates from unreliable stopping heuristics.
lead.zh: 按明确假设证明凸性与下降，分析二次特征模态和条件，区分梯度、牛顿、坐标更新与不可靠停止启发式。

prerequisites.en: Module 13: symmetric eigenmodes and positive-definite curvature; Module 18: column gradients, Hessians and correctly scaled objectives. The descent proof uses Module 16's mean value theorem and does not require an extra integration prerequisite.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 13：对称特征模态与正定曲率；模块 18：列梯度、Hessian与正确目标尺度。下降证明用模块 16 中值定理，不隐含额外积分先修。

en: Distinguish attained minimisers, infima, local/global comparisons and domain boundaries.
Prove squared-norm convexity and finite Jensen inequalities; state smooth first/second-order criteria.
Classify stationary points and identify what convexity or strong convexity adds.
Derive the Lipschitz-gradient descent bound and implement safeguarded backtracking.
Prove the quadratic eigenmode step interval and explain conditioning and coordinate scaling.
Solve Newton systems, compare coordinate updates, and diagnose singular curvature and false termination.
zh: 区分取得极小、下确界、局部全局及域边界。
证明平方范数凸与有限Jensen，写光滑一二阶判据。
分类驻点并解释凸与强凸增加什么。
推Lipschitz梯度下降界、实现保障回溯。
证明二次模态步长区间、解释条件与坐标尺度。
解牛顿系统、比较坐标更新、诊断奇异曲率及假停止。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and prove convex examples.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，证明凸例。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and prove a descent guarantee.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，证明下降保证。

text.en: Compare interior boundary and unstable steps.
text.zh: 比较区间内、边界与不稳定步长。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and explore curvature paths.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，探索曲率路径。

text.en: Compare raw and scaled coordinate iterations.
text.zh: 比较原坐标与缩放迭代。

text.en: Repair singular/non-descent systems and scaled false stops.
text.zh: 修复奇异非下降系统与缩放假停止。

text.en: Complete choices and the written convergence contract.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面收敛约定。

text.en: Read unconstrained minimisation and line-search assumptions.
text.zh: 阅读无约束与线搜索假设。

text.en: Complete the exit task and distinguish proof from training heuristic.
text.zh: 完成结业，区分证明与训练启发式。
